# Baseball Almanac

> > A comprehensive historical database of MLB statistics, records, team histories, and player biographies spanning from 1876 to 2026.

Baseball Almanac is the premier online resource for Major League Baseball research, offering extensive historical data on teams, players, awards, and championship series. The site serves as a definitive reference for baseball statistics, records, and genealogical research with coverage of all major MLB events and milestones.

## Key Topics

- World Series
- All-Star Game
- League Championship Series (ALCS/NLCS)
- Division Series
- Wild Card Game
- MLB Draft
- Baseball Hall of Fame
- Team Histories
- Player Biographies
- Opening Day
- Baseball Records
- MLB Statistics
- Historical Data
- Ballparks & Stadiums
- Player Trades

## Core References

- [Baseball Almanac: MLB Stats, History, Records & Research | 1876-2026](https://www.baseball-almanac.com): Homepage providing access to MLB stats, history, records, awards and research
- [MLB History Year-by-Year (1876-2025) | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/yearmenu.shtml): Year-by-year MLB history and statistics from 1876-2025
- [Major League Baseball Team Histories | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/teammenu.shtml): MLB team histories, stats, rosters, uniforms and schedules database
- [Baseball Biographies on Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/players/baseball_biographies.shtml): Index of original baseball player biographies and profiles

## World Series & Playoffs

- [MLB World Series: A History of the World Series | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/ws/wsmenu.shtml): Complete World Series history with data, rosters and box scores
- [MLB LCS History (1969-2026) | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/League_Championship_Series.shtml): League Championship Series history and records from 1969-2026
- [MLB Division Series History (1981-2026) | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/division_series/division_series.shtml): Division Series history and records spanning 1981-2026
- [MLB Wild Card Game (2012-2026) | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/wild_card/MLB_Wild_Card_Game.shtml): Wild Card Game history and records from 2012-2026

## All-Star Games & Special Events

- [MLB All-Star Game History | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/asgmenu.shtml): All-Star Game history, records, box scores and rosters from 1933-present
- [MLB Opening Day History | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/opening_day/opening_day.shtml): Historical reference for MLB Opening Day records and information

## Players, Draft & Transactions

- [MLB Baseball Draft (1965-2025) | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/draft/baseball_draft.shtml): Historical MLB Draft database covering 1965-2025 player selections
- [MLB Trades | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/MLB_Trades_Database.shtml): MLB trades database tracking player transactions and team trades
- [College Baseball Players Who Made it to a Major League Baseball Team | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/college/colleges.shtml): Database of college baseball players who advanced to MLB
- [Birthplace for Major League Baseball Players](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/players/birthplace.php): MLB players indexed by birthplace and geographic origin

## Awards, Records & Achievements

- [Major League Baseball Awards | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/me_award.shtml): Comprehensive directory of MLB awards and award winners throughout history
- [Baseball Feats | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/featmenu.shtml): Database of remarkable baseball feats and statistical achievements

## Management & Operations

- [MLB Baseball Managers | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/mgrmenu.shtml): Complete baseball manager database with win-loss records and history
- [Umpires in Major League Baseball | Baseabll Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/umpiresmenu.shtml): Historical database of MLB umpires and umpiring records
- [Baseball Ballparks, Baseball Stadiums and Baseball Fields](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/stadium.shtml): Statistical reference for MLB ballparks, stadiums and fields

## Optional

- [Major League Baseball Family Related Research | Baseball Almanac](https://www.baseball-almanac.com/fammenu.shtml): MLB player family genealogy and family tree research database
